settings.title: We started StoreBox because we needed a unit ourselves.

settings.editor: In 2014 the options were a damp garage or a warehouse with a four-page contract. So we built the thing we wanted to rent.

image.alt: Moving boxes stacked in a bright room beside a large window

settings.editor:
Our founders were between flats with a houseful of furniture and nowhere to put it. The places they found wanted a deposit, a twelve-month contract and a viewing appointment three days away.

So in 2014 we opened our first facility in Amsterdam Noord with one rule: it should be as easy to rent a storage unit as it is to book a hotel room. No deposit, no minimum term, and a price you can see before you call.

Twelve years and three facilities later, that is still the rule.

settings.title: Three promises we have never broken.
The price you see is the price you pay

settings.editor: No admin fee, no deposit, and no increase in your first twelve months. If a competitor is cheaper for the same size, tell us.
Only you can open your unit. Staff cannot get in without you, and we never cut a lock without a court order.
Two weeks' notice, unused days refunded. We would rather you came back than felt trapped.

settings.title: From one corridor to three facilities.

settings.editor: Grown entirely by word of mouth, which is why we still answer the phone ourselves.
84 units on a single floor of a former print works.
Noord grows to 318 units, all heated and ventilated.
Our first drive-up site: every door at ground level.
Built around business storage, with pallet delivery and racking.
The whole process moves online, from quote to PIN.
